column1: # C3 interface-vs-distal alanine scan on tnfa_corrected_40_L1r4k1, 2026-10-11.
# 6 interface + 6 distal single X->Ala, plus the unmutated parent folded IN-RUN, each with its own
# composition-matched null (random.Random(20261006) shuffle). 26 complexes x 5 seeds = 130 folds.
# Interface = side-chain tip within 5.0 A of target (his_releasing_positions_40_L1r4k1_2026-10-10.txt);
# distal = tip > 11 A. His61 excluded: A3 already measured it (+8.031 -> +0.916).
# CONTROL: the in-run parent reads +8.015 against Oct 9's +8.031 -- reproduces to 0.016.
# Bars: S1 mean interface drop >= 3.0; S2 mean distal drop <= 1.5; S3 exact one-sided
#   Mann-Whitney on the two sets of 6 drops, p <= 0.05.
#   => the margin is INTERFACE-LOCALISED. R27 is the dominant anchor (-7.732, to +0.283, i.e. into
#   null territory), ahead of His61. Two of six interface positions are NOT load-bearing (E62A
#   -0.507, K53A -0.846), which is reported rather than smoothed.
# DECLARED: this measures where ESMFold2's interface PAE signal lives. It is not binding, not
#   affinity, not pH. Two control mismatches declared before launch: no distal threonine exists
#   (T54/T57 are both interface) so that slot uses N17, and the only distal aspartate is N-terminal D1.
